b6e15be5854179e26286.headline: I Ningizimu Afrika ilungela izishingishane zasehlobo
b6e15be5854179e26286.dek: AbakwaWeather Service bathi kunezulu elinamandla elilindeleke eFree State naseGauteng, kanti izinga lokushisa lizofinyelela ku-32ºC kuya ku-36ºC uma amafu esehlile.
b6e15be5854179e26286.why: Abulimi ezifundeni ezinetha ehlobo babhekene nengozi enkulu yemvula engezansi kwesisijwayelekile kusukela ngoNovemba kuya kuMashi, kanti imiphumela emibi kakhulu kulindeleke ukuba ibonakale ngoDisemba naseJanuwari.
paragraphs: Imvula enamandla, isichotho nezishingishane sezishaye izindawo eziningi kuleli njengoba i-El Niño iqala ukubonakala. Umhloli omkhulu wezokuphepha kwesimo sezulu KwaZulu-South African Weather Service, uTokelo Chiloane, uthe izinga lokushisa lizokhuphuka uma amafu esehlile ngaphakathi kuleli, ikakhulu lihlale phakathi kuka-32ºC no-36ºC.

Umfundi wesimo sezulu uJuandre Vorster uthe izishingishane zidalwe umphumela we-El Niño nokuthi olunye uchungechunge lulindeleke eFree State naseGauteng. UMichelle du Plessis wakwa-Vox uthe iNational Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration ilindele ukuthi lesi sigameko esinamandla siqhubeke kuze kube uMashi.

UDu Plessis uthe imibono yakwaSouth African Weather Service itshengisa amathuba amakhulu emvula engezansi kwesisijwayelekile ezifundeni eziningi ezinetha ehlobo kusukela ngoNovemba kuya kuMashi. Uthe izindlela zokubona isimo sezulu zisabikezela ukuthi lesi sigameko sizofika esicongweni ngoDisemba noma ngoJanuwari.

b112829ec3de3a7dedf8.headline: Izikole zikaHulumeni zilindele ukukhuphula izimali ngo-10% ngo-2027
b112829ec3de3a7dedf8.dek: AbakwaFedsas bathi ezinye izikole zibikezela ukukhuphula ngo-12% kuya ku-15%, njengoba imindeni isinquma ukunciphisa ukuthenga ukudla nokusebenzisa imali yokonga ukuze ikhokhele imfundo.
b112829ec3de3a7dedf8.why: Imindeni esivele isebenzisa imali yokonga futhi inciphisa ukudla ukuze ikwazi ukukhokhela izikole ibhekene nokukhuphuka okungafika ku-10% ngo-2027, kanti abazali abaningi kulindeleke ukuba bafake izicelo zokuxolelwa ezimalini.
paragraphs: Izimali zezikole zikaHulumeni eziningi eNingizimu Afrika kulindeleke ukuthi zenyuke ngo-7% kuya ku-10% ngo-2027, lokhu kubeka ingcindezi enkulu emindenini esivele inciphisa ukuthenga ukudla nokusebenzisa imali yokonga ukuze izingane zihlale ezikoleni. Umfaniswano, izincwadi zokubhala, ezokuthutha kanye nezindleko zokudla nakho kungabakhona ngenyanga efana naleyo yokukhokhela isikole.

URiaan van der Bergh, iphepha laseFedsas, uthe izikole abaxoxe nazo bezilindele ukukhuphuka okungaka, kanti ezinye ezihlukile bezihlela ukukhuphula ngo-12% kuya ku-15%. Ulindele ukuthi abazali abaningi bafune ukuxolelwa ezimalini ngo-2027; abanye bavele basho ngesikhathi sokwamukelwa ukuthi bahlose ukufaka isicelo sosizo.

Izimali zezikole zasezingeni eliphansi zenyuke ngo-6% kusuka ku-2025 kuya ku-2026, kanti izimali zezikole eziphezulu zenyuke ngo-5.7%, ngokusho kweCompetition Commission. AbakwaFedsas bathi izindleko zesikole ezifana nemihlomulo, izintela zikamasipala, ugesi namanzi zenyuka ngokushesha kunezinga lokunyuka kwamanani, zicindezela izimali zezincwadi zokufunda nokulungisa izakhiwo.

49e1c54fbee2f391df41.headline: UMkhandlu waseTshwane ukhetha uNasiphi Moya njeng Mayor ngamavoti angu-115
49e1c54fbee2f391df41.dek: UMoya we-ActionSA unqobe uCilliers Brink we-DA ngevoti elifihliwe emhlanganweni wokuqala womkhandlu weDolobha laseTshwane ngoLwesine.
49e1c54fbee2f391df41.why: Amakhansela aseTshwane kumele manje asebenze ngaphansi kobuholi bukaMoya ngemuva kokuthola amavoti angu-115 kuvoti lomkhandlu.
paragraphs: UNasiphi Moya we-ActionSA unqobe ukhetho lokuba yiMayor yaseDolobheni laseTshwane ngoLwesine, mhla zingama-26 kuNovemba, athola amavoti angu-115 emhlanganweni wokuqala womkhandlu. Umlandeli we-DA uCilliers Brink uthole amavoti angu-87.

Umkhandlu ubike ukuthi kuvotelwe abantu abangu-209, kubandakanya nabangavotanga abangu-7. Ukubuya kukaMoya kulandela ukhetho lohlelo lwamakhaya luka-2026, njengoba amaqembu akha ohulumeni bomasipala futhi aqhudelana ngezikhundla zobuholi.

I-African National Congress inqobe isikhundla sikasomlomo womkhandlu, ngokukhethwa komuntu wayo uNaeem Patel. U-Omphile Maotwe we-Economic Freedom Fighters uqokwe njengePhini leMayor embikweni ohlukile.

26fb468c434293ffd3c7.headline: ITheku lihlala liyidolobha elishibhe kakhulu eNingizimu Afrika ukuthenga indlu
26fb468c434293ffd3c7.dek: Ngaphandle kwedolobha phakathi, indlu ejwayelekile lapho ithengiswa ngo-R920 000, kanti eGoli kuyisilinganiso sika-R1.1 million, ngokusho kombiko wezindlu.
26fb468c434293ffd3c7.why: Abathengi abanemali ebekiwe bangaqhathanisa isilinganiso saseThekwini sika-R920 000 nesasePitoli sika-R989 000 kanye nesaseGoli sika-R1.1 million ngaphambi kokukhetha idolobha.
paragraphs: ITheku liyidolobha elishibhe kakhulu eNingizimu Afrika ukuthenga indlu ngaphandle kwedolobha phakathi, lapho intengo yokuthengisa isilinganiso sayo ingamaR920 000, ngokusho kweThe South African. Isilinganiso sokuthengisa saseGoli kulo lonke idolobha singamaR1.1 million, kanti ama-flat phakathi nendawo eKapa abiza ngaphezulu kwamaR1 million.

Phakathi nendawo eThekwini, isilinganiso sokuthengisa singamaR420 000, kanti indlu encane idinga okungenani amaR280 000. IStatistics South Africa ibeka izinga lokungasebenzi eThekwini, umasipala ohlanganisa iTheku, ku-39.2% kusukela kwikota yesithathu. Izintengo zezindlu eThekwini zenyuke ngo-5.1% phakathi kuka-2021 no-2025.

EPitoli, isilinganiso sokuthengisa edolobheni lonke singamaR989 000, okusho ukuthi sikhuphuke ngo-16.8% eminyakeni emihlanu. Umbiko uthi intengo yesilinganiso saseGoli ngaphandle kwedolobha phakathi ayishintshanga kusukela ku-2024.

36db9e916f1675b27b54.headline: Inkantolo yaseWestern Cape ichitha umbiko wokukhishwa kukaRamaphosa
36db9e916f1675b27b54.dek: Isinqumo esamukelwa bonke siphinde saphumuza izinyathelo zePhalamende ezisekelwe embikweni, ngesikhathi i-African Transformation Movement ibonisana ngesicelo sokudlulisela udaba enkantolo ephakeme.
36db9e916f1675b27b54.why: Amalungu ekomiti noSomlomo uThoko Didiza kumele anqume ngomphumela walesi sinqumo, ngemuva kokuba ikomiti licele izeluleko emhlanganweni walo ohlelelwe mhla zingama-26 kuNovemba.
paragraphs: Inkantolo Enkhulu yaseWestern Cape eNingizimu Afrika ngoLwesithathu, mhla zingama-25 kuNovemba, ichithe umbiko owawuvule indlela yokuqala inqubo yokukhipha uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa esikhundleni. Iphaneli ephelele yanquma ngazwi linye ukuthi umbiko wephaneli ezimele wawungekho emthethweni futhi yachitha nezinyathelo ezalandela zePhalamende ezazisekelwe kuwo.

Abaquli bafumene ukuthi iphaneli, eyayiholwa owayeyiPhini leNkosi yezabaMeli uSandile Ngcobo, isebenzise uvivinya olungelona futhi yadlulela ngaphaya kwezinsolo uRamaphosa owayecelwe ukuba aziphendulele kuzo. Umbiko wephaneli kaNovemba 2022 uthe unecala lokuphendula ngama-dollar angu-$580 000 ebiwe efameni lakhe lasePhala Phala ngoFebhuwari 2020. Inkantolo ayizange inqume ngezinsolo zokuziphatha kabi ezisekhasini.

Usihlalo weKomiti yokuKhipha uMakashule Gana uthe ucele iseluleko somthetho sokuthi umhlangano wakhe ohlelelwe mhla zingama-26 kuNovemba ungaqhubeka yini. USomlomo uThoko Didiza uzofunda isinqumo, kanti i-African Transformation Movement ibonisana nabameli ngokuqondene nesicelo sokudlulisela udaba enkantolo ephakeme.
